summary: DBS Factory Gate Management backend tested via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix. Implemented pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py covering all 18 requested scenarios (auth, visitors, contractors RBAC, labours CRUD + LAB- ID format, duplicate aadhaar, search, single get, checkin/checkout with state guards, currently-inside with photo, attendance filters, admin dashboard stats, admin-only contractor PUT/DELETE). 20/20 tests passed (100%). Pre-seeded contractors 'Apex Engineering' and 'Sunrise Constructions' verified. No frontend testing done (backend-only as requested).

minor.issue: Passlib bcrypt backend logs a benign 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' warning at startup (passlib<>bcrypt 4.x compat). Auth still works because passlib falls back. Consider pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log

Date filters parse via datetime.fromisoformat which accepts naive datetimes; stored entry_datetime is tz-aware UTC. Mixed naive/aware comparisons may silently miss boundary records when callers pass naive ISO strings. Suggest normalising to UTC in the route.
Per-contractor attendance_today joins on contractor_name (string) instead of contractor_id. Renaming a contractor will orphan historical attendance from the daily count.
contractor_id filter is applied in Python after Mongo limit (post-filter). With large datasets the filter may return fewer rows than expected; push filter into Mongo query via labour lookup.

action_items: Optional: silence passlib bcrypt warning by pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib in requirements.txt.
Optional: normalise start/end query params to tz-aware UTC in visitor & attendance list endpoints.
Optional: switch dashboard per-contractor attendance_today join from contractor_name to contractor_id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
Unused FastAPI instance 'api = FastAPI()' at line 45 in server.py.
list_labours awaits _attach_contractor_name per row; for large lists this is N+1 to Mongo. Cache contractors map once per request.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed visitors, contractors (deleted within test), and labours. Created labours/attendance rows are not deleted so subsequent runs accumulate test data; aadhaar uses timestamp-based unique numbers to avoid duplicate-collisions across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints pass. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py as regression suite. Frontend (Expo web) not tested per request. If retesting after backend changes, simply rerun: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v
